notes.title: 3-Player Squads Beta Drops on December 22! Join our Discord for regular updates!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708854/ee3ededbc7806f2aa39d425f4a397c91da7fee66.png[/img]

[h1]Join us for the 3-Squirrel Squads Open Beta on December 22nd![/h1]

You asked for it!

Rally up your friends and start forming your scurries! We'll be running another Open Beta on December 22nd featuring 3-player Squads, more cosmetics, and other major updates.

[h3][u]Servers open:[/u][/h3]
[h3][b]Friday, December 22nd @ 5:00pm Pacific[/b][/h3]
[i]The session will run for approximately 4 hours[/i]

To play, simply opt-in to the Playtest on our Steam page!

[b]Wishlist[/b] today to stay updated through Steam!

[b]Join us on Discord[/b] and chat directly with the devs! https://discord.gg/rodentroyale


[b]Follow us on Twitter[/b] while you're at it! https://twitter.com/rodentroyale


See you in the neighborhood!
